Bundled OpenFreeMap style snapshots
===================================

This directory contains the dark and bright OpenFreeMap styles, sourced from
https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles at commit
72e1480dfc92858d334647037988bd2591fdb021.

The snapshots are transformed at runtime only to replace remote tile and font
URLs with Volty's local PMTiles loopback server and to remove decorations that
need an unavailable sprite atlas.  The original repository is MIT-licensed:
Copyright (c) 2023 Zsolt Ero.

The styles derive from OpenMapTiles / OSM Bright GL Style.  Their code is BSD
3-Clause and visual design is CC BY 4.0.  Volty exposes the required map
attribution in the map corner: © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.
See the upstream LICENSE.md for the full notices:
https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles/blob/72e1480dfc92858d334647037988bd2591fdb021/LICENSE.md
